raw_text: AI News Anchors Used to Spread Fake Anti-India Content, Servers Traced to Pakistan and China. NDTV reports that a network of YouTube channels using AI-generated news anchors has been broadcasting fabricated anti-India news content including false narratives about economic collapse and internal unrest. Investigations by Graphika and Stanford Internet Observatory trace the hosting infrastructure to servers in Islamabad and Shenzhen. India's Ministry of Electronics and IT has directed platforms to remove the channels and block associated accounts.
